description: Frozen public-engine callable recall obligations from independently authored review programs. Synthetic language cases, not natural application discoveries. Runtime witnesses corroborate the source rationales. Null-shortening controls deliberately scope assertions to receiver callables.

cases.name: captured_reassignment
cases.rationale: The named callback reads the captured cell only after replacement; the initial method body is never called.

cases.name: alias_before_rebind
cases.rationale: The alias keeps the original object; replacement does not modify the saved value.

cases.name: formal_reassignment
cases.rationale: The formal is overwritten before its only method invocation.

cases.name: loop_reassignment
cases.rationale: The bounded loop executes one replacement before the only receiver invocation.

cases.name: alias_chain_snapshot
cases.rationale: Two aliases preserve the old value; rebinding the original variable does not change either alias.

cases.name: alias_chain_both_values
cases.rationale: The added call uses the rebound variable, so both old and new methods execute.

cases.name: formal_write_after_snapshot
cases.rationale: Saving but never using the old argument does not execute its method; the formal is overwritten before the call.

cases.name: formal_saved_value_used
cases.rationale: The saved formal argument and its new value are both used, preventing an unsound overwrite kill.

cases.name: loop_guaranteed_write
cases.rationale: A do-loop executes its write once even with a false condition; continue reaches the condition.

cases.name: loop_zero_trip_old_value
cases.rationale: A while-loop with a false condition executes no write; separately allocating Blue prevents allocation absence from hiding this control.

cases.name: callback_reads_mutable_cell
cases.rationale: A callback passed through a synchronous helper reads the current variable value when called, not when created.

cases.name: callback_reads_saved_value
cases.rationale: Only changing the captured binding to saved restores the original receiver; the overwritten variable is unused.

cases.name: returned_callback_after_local_write
cases.rationale: A called nested function mutates the captured cell before its reader escapes and is invoked.

cases.name: returned_callback_before_and_after
cases.rationale: The same callback is invoked before and after the nested write; both receivers must remain live.

cases.name: async_reads_after_resume
cases.rationale: The call to later starts before rebinding, but its receiver read occurs after await resumes; no sleeps or external scheduling inputs.

cases.name: async_reads_saved_snapshot
cases.rationale: Across the same suspension, saved still holds the old object; treating every capture as the latest receiver would be wrong.

cases.name: null_chain
cases.rationale: The null sink skips the entire chained call/setter RHS; the original method and helper must remain live. This control does not require pruning skipped constructors or Sink members.

cases.name: nonnull_chain
cases.rationale: The nonnull sink evaluates the write before current.fire; the original method and helper are dead.

cases.name: null_setter
cases.rationale: The null sink skips the entire chained call/setter RHS; the original method and helper must remain live. This control does not require pruning skipped constructors or Sink members.

cases.name: nonnull_setter
cases.rationale: The nonnull sink evaluates the write before current.fire; the original method and helper are dead.

cases.name: ordinary_assignment
cases.rationale: An ordinary local write replaces the first object before its sole method call. The constructed owner remains live; its unused method does not.
